segments: "BUS STOP" in bold white text fades in on a black screen, then quickly fades out
Shot of the sun, bright in a clear sky. Faint music plays in the background
A black SUV roars into frame before screeching to a stop. The man turns his head to look
Camera cuts back to the woman. She dials something on the payphone before slamming the phone down and turning away in frustration. She has her hands held up to her mouth, perhaps in worry
The woman notices the man and starts walking towards him. Her car starts to roll away in the background. Tense music starts playing in the background

The woman shouts, "Hey! Hey, excuse me? Can I borrow your phone" as she mimes a phone while walking towards the man. The man sort of looks away, pretending not to see her until she gets close. He starts to take his headphones off
While calling, the woman paces back and front on the street. She says "I'm here. I said I'm here"
Now shouting and pacing faster, the woman says, "Excuse me, I will go to the police, okay?!"
The woman throws the phone down onto the street in anger.
The man, crouching with his broken phone in his hand, squints at the woman. He says "Miss? Miss this phone is broken. Are you going to get like 60 bucks for it or something? Miss?"
The woman, looking away, says "He's here." She turns her head slightly and the man asks "Are you okay?
Camera cuts to a view behind a 2nd man as he drives under a bridge. Loud horn music plays
The camera cuts to the woman and the red shirted man, who turn to look at to their right
The woman starts walking forward to the car in the distance. The man says, "Miss?"
Camera cuts again to the man in the car, who's looking at the woman approaching. He clicks off the music
The woman gets closer to the man, now outside of his car. She mumbles, "This time you've gone too far, you've gone way too far. I'm, I'm not - "
The 2nd man says, "What the heck Charelle?" to which the woman replies, "Fuck you, Bob"
Camera cuts back to the 2nd man, who repeats, "A friend?" He gets up
The 1st man says "Oh shit, you're Aldini the great, you do the magic show"
The woman pulls out a gun, pointing it at the 1st man, shouting "Shut up!" She turns the gun towards the 2nd man, shouting "Shut up!" again.
The magician continues, "Well guess what?" he reaches forward and a small gun appears in his hand. He says, "I've got one of my own"
The woman then points her gun up into the air and fires a shot. The 1st man winces
Camera then cuts to the car. A howl/cry is heard.
The woman looks at the car before  starting to run towards it
Camera cuts to the woman at the car. She's desperately trying to open the trunk of the car. More howls/cries can be heard

Close up of the handkerchief held by the magician. In it, there's a relic of some sort, a small coffin shaped thing with a cross on top. The magician starts to open the coffin and starts saying "Delicate is he who loathes, the fleshy fabric of his clothes"
The camera cuts to the woman at the car, who's struggling with the trunk. The magician continues speaking in the background
The man drops his plastic bag and the melted ice cream starts to pour out. The magician's voice continues, extremely deep
Camera cuts to the 1st man, lying on the floor with his tongue out and eyes closed, next to the magician's foot and a pool of melted ice cream on the floor
Camera cuts to a view of the magician, looking down at the man. He says, "Son of a bitch" under his breath
The camera cuts to the woman, near the car. She starts walking towards the other two with her gun drawn. The magician continues to read the spell out loud in the background
The camera cuts to the magician on the floor, bleeding. He holds his gun up and fires before going limp. The 1st man continues to bark
The first man continues to eat the ice cream on the floor with his mouth.
The camera pans right to reveal a woman in a white dress, also on all fours and barking. The man and the woman bark at each other.
The man crawls into frame and starts sniffing the woman's rear while barking. She does the same.
The man and the woman start crawling away, next to the car and barking.
